reason: scripts/update_contract_lock.py was changed from whole-commit lock generation to contract_surface_lock generation. The follow-up repair makes the surface hash come from the committed Semantic Substrate git tree identified by contract_sha, not from uncommitted working-tree files.
user_intent_alignment_summary: The user explicitly required consumer locks to validate the Semantic Substrate contract authority surface rather than every Substrate repo commit, and required generated locks not to encode dirty working-tree state.
diff_review_summary: The script still resolves EXCEPTIONS_LAKE_CONTRACT_REPO_PATH, builds a deterministic contracts.lock.json document, and writes contracts.lock.json. The replacement adds committed-tree hashing via git show and git ls-tree, records contract_surface_lock metadata, and keeps deterministic document construction. It does not add runtime authority, schema ownership, lifecycle authority, or front-door authority to the Exception Lake.
why_merge_not_sufficient: Keeping the old working-tree hash path would preserve the exact provenance bug found by Codex: a lock could claim a committed SHA while carrying a hash computed from uncommitted local files.
replacement_justification: A committed-tree hash is required for a truthful lock. The old logic could not safely support contract_surface_lock.computed_from_commit because it read files from disk. The new logic preserves the lock update workflow while narrowing the contract authority surface to the registry-defined files.
alternatives_considered: Leave the script unchanged and rely only on the central Substrate updater. Rejected because the local consumer updater would still be capable of producing misleading locks.
Validate whole Substrate commit SHA only. Rejected because that reintroduces recursive drift from non-authority audit and decision records.
removed_content_summary: Prior whole-tree or working-tree surface computation path
Implicit trust that the working tree matched the stamped commit
source_refs: Codex FAIL blocker: consumer lock provenance mismatch
